airRouteControl.name: Concrete body -> complete bottom bed -> bonded DPC body/perpends/upper bed -> wall core below plaster stop -> plaster
rules: First compare the actual bonded mineral assembly as a complete air transition; neither brick absorption nor mortar designation demonstrates its leakage
Include the 30 mm wall-core height above DPC and below plaster stop; do not jump from DPC top -30 to plaster at0
Do not plaster continuously down to wet RC and around the DPC; do not close an air drawing by creating a damp bypass
Concrete moisture resistance, air permeability, crack/joint leakage and gas suitability remain separate duties
Do not assume a new metal return is needed or qualified; if used it needs actual cast-in depth, cage/compaction, weld, movement and plaster-interface evidence

thresholdAirOverlap.role: Ordinary dry-side air-control development control, not an actual seal/product or pressure-water closure
thresholdAirOverlap.rule: Ideal no-slip, steady laminar, fully developed central-slot sensitivity derived from pressure-driven momentum balance; uniform connected gap and constant properties. Not measured leakage, an installed rating, an adopted allocation or a strict assembly bound. Entry/end effects, variable-gap paths, deformation and achieved tolerances remain unqualified; especially the largest gaps must not be treated as a supplied joint performance.
thresholdAirOverlap.waterDuty: No source-qualified head is assigned to this dry apron behind the +15 mm crest. Quiet water −35 mm and geometric crest +15 mm are not a first-leak rating; firstSusceptible remains null. No closed E roof/pipe pressure duty is transferred. Water/capillary/end qualification remains independent.
thresholdAirOverlap.toleranceRole: The 2 mm movement and 1 mm edge tolerances are authored challenge bounds, not actual fabrication/installation tolerances. Gap control is an unproven requirement on formed faces and supports, not an achieved fit.
thresholdAirOverlap.ends: No actual end gap or end closure is authored. Every gap result is central only and cannot be credited as total assembly leakage.
thresholdAirOverlap.renewal: Ordinary retention/cover must be independently supported and entirely released before NORTH 500 mm withdrawal; no permanent field-to-pan weld or through-pan fixing. No high preload is inferred from air duty alone.

currentHADReconciliation.role: Actual merged RWT checkpoint; compare the named relevant projections with the intentionally pinned floor/pan case. Changed receiver/maintenance and other source roles are not relabelled as unchanged.
